label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1, late in the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent chose a2 and reached S1, a rare transition (98% of mass has in_action=a2, 96% has in_state=S1). It is strongly gated by episode position: silent before trial 80, and 93% of mass falls in trials 90-99. That shows up as a low value-head output, since 99% of mass is in the bottom value bin (<5.22). Magnitude grows toward the end of the episode and with repeated a2->S1R trials; the top activations (~1.0) are on the last trials. Reward, stay and the good state matter little. Dev scores: a2&S1 at D2 alone gives F1 0.19 (mass recall 0.94); adding ep_trial>=85 gives F1 0.74; adding value<5.22 (recorded) gives F1 0.80 and mass recall 0.93. Missed activations are weak (low-quartile) firings on common trials late in the episode. All variables used are observed at D2 (the action, the reached state, the model value). No future variable is used. It never fires at D1/GO, after a1, or before trial 80.
